title: Chester Curling Club
specs: 4-sheet heated curling facility with lockers, bar, lounge, and viewing area
Robust Junior Program with recognized competitive teams
Juniors must be under 21 on June 30 of the membership year for junior categories
All members must sign a Safety Waiver before beginning play each season
Juniors or their guardians must fill out and sign a medical/contact information form
Leagues for all ages and experience levels including juniors and adults
Teams are mixed gender in Day Curling; other leagues have various formats

options.name: One Session One League Adult Membership
Second Adult in Same Household Membership

includes: Use of lounge, viewing areas, and change rooms
Participation in curling activities and provincial championships for which qualified
Ability to attend and vote at members’ meetings (except some junior and social memberships)
gap: Age minimum not explicitly stated for adult memberships
blurb: Guests participate in curling leagues and social events at a 4-sheet heated facility with lounge and viewing areas. The club offers various membership types for adults and juniors, including drop-in and league play. Programs include junior instruction, social leagues, and practice ice booking.

extraNote: Non-members may spare by paying a $20 fee and completing waiver forms · Practice Status members are not eligible for regular leagues · If a game is cancelled, a make-up game can be played before the last scheduled date or the cancelling team takes the loss · If a game is not made up by the deadline, the cancelling team must accept the loss · Chester Curling Club, 190 Pig Loop Road, Chester, N.S.
